note: Crédit Mutuel de Maine-Anjou et Basse-Normandie's fee information document (1 January 2026): keeping an Eurocompte Confort account costs 2.15 euros a month (25.80 a year). Crédit Mutuel's regional federations each set their own prices; this is one federation's. Read again 2026-10-30: each irregular operation (a payment past the balance without an authorised overdraft) costs a commission d’intervention of 7.90 EUR (at most 7.90 a day and 80 a month, caps the form doesn't hold; the overdraft rate is in the full price list, not read); an occasional SEPA transfer online costs nothing; a withdrawal in euros at another bank's machine in the euro area is free for the first four a month and 1.00 EUR from the fifth (written as free). The international debit card is 44.40 EUR a year on its own but is part of the Eurocompte Confort package (6.90 EUR a month in this document), so no card fee is written beside the account's. Not stated: a returned payment, interest, a share on another currency, a transfer outside SEPA, what opening asks, a savings account.
